<description>
In `doc/i2p.md`, the Compatibility section stated that any SAM v3.1 router can be used.
Bitcoin Core now relies on a feature that requires recent routers:

- `i2cp.leaseSetEncType=6,4` (introduced in #35696)

This is supported by Java I2P ≥ 2.10.0 and i2pd ≥ 2.58.0.

This pull updates the routers list with those minimum versions and adjusts the Compatibility section.
</description>
